name: A portrait of John Dent
summary: A study for a portrait in oils of John Dent (1821-1892), whose unles had established Dent & Co. as one of the leading British firms engaged in trade with China. John Dent was conspicuous in the commercial and social life of Hong Kong during the first 25 years of the colony's existence.
